defects.why: A shared denominator does not establish that overall and per-transaction counts use the same window or represent comparable scopes.

notes: Detailed and mostly sound, but it incorrectly infers a shared window from the denominator.
Accurate, well-scoped advice with hypotheses clearly separated from facts.

defects.quote: The evidence consists of aggregate metric summaries only
defects.why: The evidence also contains a policy_check and recorded verdict facts.

defects.quote: no anomalies were flagged by this analysis
defects.why: No anomaly-detector result is present, so an empty findings array cannot establish that anomaly analysis ran or flagged nothing.

notes: Useful follow-up checks, but it overstates what empty findings establish.

defects.quote: single run at a single load level
defects.why: The evidence provides no load-level or stage definition, so calling it a single load level invents unavailable structure.

notes: Otherwise carefully scoped and contract-aware, but it invents a load-level characterization.
Correctly preserves the verdict and keeps aggregate-based explanations explicitly hypothetical.
